title: BAID: A Benchmark for Bias Assessment of AI Detectors

bias_targets.target: Demographic bias (Race, Gender, Socioeconomic, Disability, ELL)
bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance (precision, recall, F1) of AI text detectors on human-written persuasive essays annotated with metadata for author race/ethnicity, gender, socioeconomic status, disability status, and English Language Learner (ELL) status.
Comparing AI text detector performance on human-written blog posts grouped into four author age ranges: teens, 20s, 30s, and 40s.
Comparing AI text detector performance on human-written student essays categorized by educational grade levels ranging from 8 to 12 to observe the effects of writing maturity.

Comparing AI text detector performance across different English linguistic varieties, specifically African American Vernacular English (AAVE), Singaporean English (Singlish), and Standard American English (SAE).
Comparing AI text detector performance on paired datasets contrasting informal phrasing (GenZ English) with formal standard English equivalents.
Comparing AI text detector performance across ten major topical categories (e.g., Arts, Media, Law, Technology) sourced from blog posts.
Comparing AI text detector performance on news articles annotated as left-leaning, neutral, or right-leaning to evaluate ideological sensitivity.
